title: Combined Solids and Recasting
summary: Surface areas and volumes of solids made from cubes, cylinders, cones and hemispheres, and converting one solid into another.
objectives: I can find the surface area of a combined solid.
I can find the volume of a combined solid.
I can solve melting and recasting problems.
misconceptions: The surface area of a combined solid is the sum of the surface areas of its parts.
